    matrix = case['matrix']
    idf = case['idf']
    vector = case['vector']
    num_terms = len(idf)
    result = [0.0] * num_terms
    for i, row in enumerate(matrix):
        weight = vector[i]
        for j, val in enumerate(row):
            result[j] += weight * val * idf[j]
    return result"}
